def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    n = len(source)
    while i < n:
        c = source[i]
        if c in ' \t\n\r':
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == ';':
            while i < n and source[i] != '\n':
                i += 1
            continue
        if c == '(':
            tokens.append(('(', None))
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == ')':
            tokens.append((')', None))
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == "'":
            tokens.append(("'", None))
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == '"':
            i += 1
            parts = []
            while i < n and source[i] != '"':
                if source[i] == '\\':
                    i += 1
                    if i >= n:
                        raise SchemeError("unterminated string escape")
                    if source[i] == '"': parts.append('"')
                    elif source[i] == '\\': parts.append('\\')
                    elif source[i] == 'n': parts.append('\n')
                    else: raise SchemeError("bad escape: \\" + source[i])
                    i += 1
                else:
                    parts.append(source[i])
                    i += 1
            if i >= n:
                raise SchemeError("unterminated string")
            i += 1  # skip closing "
            tokens.append(('str', ''.join(parts)))
            continue
        # atom
        start = i
        while i < n and source[i] not in ' \t\n\r()";\'':
            i += 1
        tok = source[start:i]
        if tok:
            tokens.append(('atom', tok))
    return tokens
